title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Kinds of Loss Each Tier Pays and the Reefer Rank for Temperature Damage
content:
Every tier of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` pays only for the kinds of loss it lists, and pays for temperature damage only where the refrigerated service on the container reaches a minimum rank.

## Rules

1. Payment is made solely for kinds of loss listed as covered by the tier. A claim for any other kind of loss is rejected as not covered by the tier.
2. Temperature damage is covered only where the reefer service tier of the container claimed ranks at least as high as the tier's minimum reefer rank. Below that rank, a temperature damage claim is likewise rejected as not covered by the tier.
3. The reefer service consulted is the one the line's records hold in the cover holder's name, on the booking under the cover, for the very container the notice names. A container with no reefer service counts as rank 0.

## Kinds of loss covered

| Tier | Kinds of loss covered | Minimum reefer rank for temperature damage |
|---|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | physical damage, wet damage, temperature damage, contamination, shortage, total loss | 1 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | physical damage, wet damage, temperature damage, contamination, shortage, total loss | 1 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | physical damage, wet damage, shortage, total loss | 1 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | physical damage, wet damage, temperature damage, contamination, shortage, total loss | 2 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | physical damage, wet damage, temperature damage, contamination, shortage, total loss | 1 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | physical damage, wet damage, temperature damage, contamination, shortage, total loss, delay loss | 1 |

## Reefer service ranks

| Reefer service tier | Rank |
|---|---|
| `AHL Reefer Standard` | 1 |
| `AHL Reefer Monitored` | 2 |
| `AHL Reefer Cold Treatment` | 3 |
| `AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere` | 4 |
| `AHL Reefer Pharma GDP` | 5 |
| `AHL Reefer Superfreezer` | 6 |
| no reefer service on the container | 0 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A contamination claim under `AHL CargoCare Essential`: contamination is not a kind that tier covers, so the ground applies.
- A temperature damage claim under `AHL CargoCare Plus` on a container under `AHL Reefer Standard`: rank 1 is below the minimum of 2, so the ground applies. Under `AHL Reefer Monitored` the rank of 2 suffices.
- A temperature damage claim under `AHL CargoCare Premium` on a container with no reefer service: rank 0 is below 1, so the ground applies.
- A delay loss claim under `AHL CargoCare Premium`: delay loss is not listed for that tier, so the ground applies.
